reason.name: git-push-force
reason.because: Overwrites remote history unconditionally, including work you have not seen.

reason.name: git-reset-hard
reason.because: Discards commits and the working tree with them. Recoverable only via the reflog, if you know to look.

reason.name: git-stash-clear
reason.because: Drops every stash at once. There is no reflog for stashes you cleared.

reason.name: git-clean-force
reason.because: Removes untracked and ignored files, including .env files and local-only config that was never committed.
